hooks.name: herdr-session-start
hooks.description: Reports session ID, resume command, and idle state to Herdr

hooks.name: herdr-before-agent
hooks.description: Reports working state to Herdr on turn start

hooks.name: herdr-notification
hooks.description: Reports blocked state to Herdr when waiting for user permission

hooks.name: herdr-before-tool
hooks.description: Reports working state to Herdr when approved tool executes

hooks.name: herdr-after-agent
hooks.description: Reports idle state to Herdr on turn completion

hooks.name: herdr-session-end
hooks.description: Releases pane ownership in Herdr when session terminates
